tools.name: avirato_list_reservations
tools.description: Reservations of the establishment between two dates (reservation id, channel booking id, room, rate, guest name and document, check-in/out, price, paid and outstanding, status, notes) plus a summary of counts by status. Dates are whole days (yyyy-mm-dd) or exact date-times. GET /reservation/betweenD

tools.name: avirato_get_reservation
tools.description: One reservation by the hotel's own booking id, or by a channel's booking id together with the channel (operator) id. Returns the booking(s) with guest, room, rate, dates, price, paid and outstanding amounts and status. Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/{bookingId}.

tools.name: avirato_get_reservation_details
tools.description: Extended information of one reservation by its booking id (the reservationInfo view). Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/reservationInfo.

tools.name: avirato_get_related_reservations
tools.description: A reservation with the other reservations of the same group (master booking and its related rooms). Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/related/{reservationId}.

tools.name: avirato_list_all_reservations
tools.description: Every reservation of the establishment in the PMS (can be a very large list for an old hotel; prefer avirato_list_reservations with a date range). Returns `limit` entries from `offset` (default the first 100), the total count and next_offset. Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/allReservat

tools.name: avirato_list_booking_channels
tools.description: The sales channels (operators: OTAs, own website, ...) that book into the establishment, with their operator ids (used by avirato_get_reservation). GET /reservation/operators.

tools.name: avirato_check_availability
tools.description: Availability of rooms for a stay: which room types and rooms are free between check-in and check-out, optionally limited to a room category, rooms, room types or zones. GET /availability.

tools.name: avirato_list_available_spaces
tools.description: The free rooms (spaces) of one room category between two dates. GET /availability/availableSpaces.

tools.name: avirato_get_unavailable_dates
tools.description: The dates a room (space) is not free from a start date on, ignoring the given booking (useful to check whether a booking can be extended or moved). GET /availability/unavailable-dates.

tools.name: avirato_get_booking_engine_overview
tools.description: The booking-engine start data between two dates: room types with descriptions and availability, meal plans (diets), taxes, extras and billing configuration. The quickest way to learn the room type, space type and rate ids of the establishment. GET /rate/init.

tools.name: avirato_list_rates
tools.description: The rates of the establishment (name, minimum/maximum stay, refundable, linked rate and percentage, release days, room category), optionally only some rate ids and one rate mode. GET /rate.

tools.name: avirato_list_rates_by_room_category
tools.description: All rates of the establishment, optionally limited to some rate ids and room categories (space types). GET /rate/all.

tools.name: avirato_get_rate
tools.description: One rate by id: name, stay limits, refundable, linked and master rate, release days and mode. GET /rate/{rateId}.

tools.name: avirato_get_price
tools.description: The final price of a stay for one room type and rate, with discounts and increments applied, for a number of adults, children, meal plan and rooms. GET /rate/getPrice.

tools.name: avirato_get_prices_map
tools.description: Prices per room type and rate for each day of a period, with the establishment's taxes. GET /rate/getPricesMap.

tools.name: avirato_get_discounts
tools.description: The discounts and increments that apply to room types and rates for a period and a number of rooms. GET /rate/discounts.

tools.name: avirato_list_diets
tools.description: The meal plans (diets) of the establishment with their ids, as used by the price tools. GET /rate/diets.

tools.name: avirato_list_rate_releases
tools.description: The release (minimum advance booking) days of each rate. GET /rate/release.

tools.name: avirato_get_minimum_stay
tools.description: The minimum-stay restrictions per day for room types and rates over a period. GET /restrictions/minimum-stay.

tools.name: avirato_get_daily_prices
tools.description: The daily prices of one rate on one date (per room type and occupancy). GET /dailyPrice.

tools.name: avirato_list_promotional_packages
tools.description: The promotional packages of the establishment with their extras. GET /payment/promotionalPackages.

tools.name: avirato_list_extras
tools.description: The extras (additional services) that can be charged on a booking. GET /payment/extras.

tools.name: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment
tools.description: WRITE: records a cash payment on an existing booking in the hotel's PMS (it changes the booking's paid and outstanding amounts and cannot be undone through this server). Not idempotent: calling it twice records two payments. Confirm the booking id and the amount with the user first, then pass confir

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment · Private data: avirato_list_reservations, avirato_add_booking_cash_payment · Public sink: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment · Private data: avirato_list_reservations, avirato_add_booking_cash_payment · Public sink: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
